security_assessment.default_deny_and_identity: Explicit feature flag, nonempty authenticated user/chat/project grants; no trusted user_id from JSON or localhost promotion.
security_assessment.authorization: Producer create/read/preview separated from start; manifest publication separate capability; no main writes, automatic merge, client registry/root override or alias bypass.
security_assessment.git: Source blob hashes and immutable manifest/source provenance separated; ambiguous publish reconciliation and external capability blockers explicit.
security_assessment.miniapp: Raw initData HMAC, freshness, constant-time signature comparison, duplicate rejection, one-use exchange, hash storage, user-instance-challenge binding, current ACL and replay rejection specified.
security_assessment.gateway: Scoped secure sessions, CSRF/origin on mutation/WS, no GET consumption, server-owned loopback upstream and allowlisted routes, no legacy public fallthrough.
security_assessment.later_implementation_focus: Prove initData replay prevention across new challenges/sessions, atomic exchange races and current ACL revocation with implementation tests; architecture text states these invariants but runtime is not delivered in this stage.
security_assessment.evidence: All 16 acceptance scenarios remain NOT_RUN; real external model/mobile/tunnel/PR gates explicitly not claimed. No live credentials used or external instance contacted.

primary_sources.supports: Raw initData HMAC and auth_date verification; do not trust initDataUnsafe.
